fluff.overview: Tau Wraith reconnaissance squads served as the Manei Domini's eyes on the battlefield, operating from the shadows to coordinate friendly forces and provide targeting telemetry for heavier units. Where Tau Zombies overwhelmed through brute cybernetic force, Wraiths relied on stealth and information superiority. Each six-trooper squad wore Sneak Suits incorporating camouflage, ECM, and infrared baffling that rendered them invisible to standard detection equipment, including active probes. Their boosted communicator implants allowed Wraiths to link directly into friendly C3 networks, sharing real-time battlefield data without the need for external communications gear. Armed with Mauser 1200 LSS laser rifles and equipped with paratrooper drop capability, Wraith squads could insert behind enemy lines and remain undetected while guiding strikes from friendly formations. Few conventional forces could match their combination of stealth, communications integration, and cybernetic enhancement.
